docs.title: Welcome to the Britdan Archives
docs.text:
This website will searve as the perminant home for all of my projects, old and new, going forward.

This is everything from mappacks to mods to tilesets to projects and much, much more.

docs.title: Work In Progress
docs.text: This website is still a massive work in progress, so please keep in mind that everything is still vulnerable to change. And typos will likely always appear but I do appriciate any reports.

12 Maps Of Christmas 3 is a winter themed platformer based on SMB and another obvious sequel to 12 Maps Of Christmas 2 released for Alesan99's Entities, Originally released on the 23rd of December, 2020. It features 12 levels with 4 additional bonus levels with 1 being locked behind getting 36 purple coins. The mappack is fairly lackluster and despite having some unique ideas it's fairly boring.

docs.title: Interesting Facts
docs.text:
• This mappack was blaintantly stolen and rerelased as "Xmas Scary 3" which featured edited levels and very load jumpscares, since the release of my video mocking it the original has been taken down.
  • This mappack features many easter eggs, mainly little pixel representations of emojis from the unoffical Stabyourself.net discord server.
  • in 2-4, entering one of the last green pipes might lead you to something special.

(The) Hidden Ones is a unique short, 3 world mappack and release for Alesan99's Entities on the 22nd of June 2020. It features a grassy, desert and apocalyptic world with 2 custom bosses. It was one of if not the first mappack to be released for the then much anticipated V13. Overall the mappack has ages very poorly and is no where near the quality of it's seaquel mappack Lies Awaken.

The original version featured a working world map which also contained additonal content like bonus minigames but was removed due to issues and the functionalliy was lost to time.

docs.text:
Mappack CardFirst LevelTileset

The mappacks icon, name and description.

A screenshot of the first level from the mappack.

The tileset used in the mappack.

Hidden Ones Lies Awaken is a semi-open world mappack where you must collect purple coins within multiple areas, it was released for Alesan99's Entities on the 1st of August, 2022, It features 4 main areas and 4 bonus areas. The mappack features several custom mechanics such as a waypoint system allowing fast travel between parts of the map and quick respawn checkpoints that function without restarting the level. It also features a custom Dialog system that allows for more flexibility.

docs.text: Tons of enemies and general help by WilliamFrog.

HIM is the first entry in the HIM tetrolagy, it's a horror mappack heavily inspired by Slenderman and the eight pages, it was released for Alesan99's Entities on the 29th of October, 2020. The goal is to collect 10 mushrooms before the cursed goomba catches you, it features 5 difficulties from practace to very hard.

docs.title: Interesting Facts
docs.text: • It is by far my most infamous creation, most notibly by being featured in a Blue Televison Games video which is now sitting at 1.9 Million Views as of the 28th of September, 2026, cursed goombas has gone on to be featured in some facinating places, from random youtube thumbnails to redbubble skirts to litteral porn, this guy has seen the world!

docs.text:
Mappack CardFirst LevelTileset

The mappacks icon, name and description.

A screenshot of the first level from the mappack.

The tileset used in the mappack.

Minecr0ft Is a short 1 world mappack split into 6 full scale levels based on Minecraft and released for Alesan99's Entities on the 7th of May 2020. It features several areas based on the game from plains to underground to the nether and end. The mappack also comes with a built in "Creative" mode that is rather disapointing. As well as the final version, a Demo was released that contains just the first level, it is almost the same as the final version minus some small things like lacking mobs and a custom font.

docs.title: Interesting Facts
docs.text: • There was also an unreleased expansion that was meant to be souly focused around a "Creative mode" but was scrapped because it would not be worth the effort when people could just use the editor.
